newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end mixed, led by banks shares.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end mixed, led by banks shares.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed after a day that appropriately saw blue-chip Banco Ganadero post simultaneous losses and gains.
Medellin's IBOMED general price index rose a timid 0.24 percent to close at 13,549.79 on a trading volume of 2.4 billion pesos.
Bogota's IBB index fell 0.43 percent, meanwhile, ending at 870.17 on a lackluster volume of 1.07 billion pesos.
The index in Bogota was dragged down by heavily traded Banco de Colombia, the country's second-largest bank in terms of assets.
Brokers said the bank fell 3.50 percent on profit-taking to end at 440 pesos per share. Ordinary shares of Banco Ganadero also trended lower in Bogota, ending down 1.41 percent at 279 pesos a share.
Banco Industrial Colombiano bucked the downward trend, however, closing up 1.98 percent at 3,600 pesos per share.
Other gainers included brewer Bavaria SA, which rose 0.25 percent to close at 3,910 pesos per share and Cementos Diamante, up 2.22 percent at 3,905 pesos a share.
Banco Ganadero's preferential shares gained an impressive 3.0 percent in Medellin, ending at 206 pesos per share.
The bank's ordinary shares ended lower, however, slipping 2.44 percent to close at 279 pesos per share.
Brokers said investors in Ganadero, the country's most heavily traded stock in August, were continuing in their concerted effort to narrow the spread between preferential and ordinary shares.
Bavaria, the country's third most active stock in August after Banco de Colombia, closed up 2.56 percent in Medellin at 3,910 pesos per share.
